**Synopsis:**
Bitcoin surged ~30% recently, breaking a pattern of lower highs that had formed since May 2026, driven by the U.S. Treasury doubling buyback sizes for long-duration debt. Price cleared all major moving averages with golden cross signals. Key bull/bear lines are clearly identified: bulls need to hold above ~$71,781 and break above $82,793 (the May high / 61.8% Fibonacci retracement zone) to target $90K–$97,867. Bears regain control on a close below $75,674 and $71,781, risking a drop to $62,677 and the 2026 low of $57,776. A hawkish pivot from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh (tighter policy signal) is flagged as a near-term headwind for bitcoin.
